paths.quote: because int / int is integer division
paths.logic: counts[i][j] / degree[i] gives the correct probability because the result is stored in a double.
paths.twin_logic: counts[i][j] / outDegree[i] with two int operands is integer division and gives 0 whenever counts < outDegree; SW's Transition avoids it by multiplying by .90 first, and RandomSurfer casts with (double) freq[i] / T.
